name: Unrusted: Chicago - A denser South and Westside Chicago
author: NoahGarrf
description:
This mod asks the question: What if Chicago's South and West sides never declined, what if the southside never deindustrialized, what if Gary was a thriving satellite city? Well here we are, the way this mod works is pretty simple:

Step 1. Download and turn on the mod
Step 2. Open the Chicago map or an existing chicago save you have
Step 3. Press the lightning button on the top right corner of the screen
Step 4. Wait around 30 seconds for demand to generate (Game will freeze while this occurs)
Step 5. Start building and enjoying your boosted chicago demand, make sure you save before closing the game though!

This one is muuuuuch fancier than the previous detroit one, it kind of had to be in order to only boost specific portions of the city, to do this I created multiple polygons that affect the populations within, some of these generate new pops and modify existing ones, some just exist to pull cross commuters. I added a lot of special demand on the south side with colleges and factories (I.E the stockyards or US Steel's Gary plant). There are also some corridors with additional density like congress ave or MLK/Cotton Grove. Overall its pretty dope I think, you should like totally download this mod ; )
